minor.issue: Regex ^(coin_|ludo_|aviator_|matka_).*_win$ requires an underscore between prefix and _win, so short types like 'coin_win' don't match — the response returned 0 rows even though the user had a WIN transaction (Wins Amount card showed +₹100). Fix: change regex to ^(...).*_(win|loss|bet)$|^(...)(win|loss|bet)$ or split by suffix without the extra separator requirement. This is a pre-existing backend bug — E1's fix is purely frontend.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both requested refactors are PASSING. Admin 'Wallet Tx' now lives inside user drawer and is scoped correctly with user_id. Bets page has refresh button and desc-by-created_at sort using utcDate. Note: could not place a fresh coin bet during test because the coin gateway flow (from dashboard) didn't behave as expected in the automation (clicking gateway-box-coin ended up on /bets — likely because coin game requires round countdown UI); sort correctness has been verified via code review of the ts() sort in fetchBets. Also flagged an orthogonal pre-existing backend regex bug where /api/admin/wallet/game-transactions with type_filter=win returns 0 rows for simple type names like 'coin_win'.
rca of the issue: Backend regex: pattern = '^(coin_|ludo_|aviator_|matka_).*_win$' requires at least one '_' between the game prefix and '_win', so a type like 'coin_win' (prefix + 'win') fails to match because after consuming 'coin_' only 'win' remains and '.*_win$' needs '_win' at the end. Fix: use pattern like '^(coin_|ludo_|aviator_|matka_).*(win|loss|bet)$' matching just the suffix keyword (no leading underscore) OR pattern like '^(coin_|ludo_|aviator_|matka_)([a-z_]*_)?win$'.
